meta.title: AHS Executive Truth Review
meta.evidence_boundary: Read-only observation and source reconciliation. No production closure, restore proof, device acceptance, or role-matrix acceptance is claimed.

hero.title: AHS is observable and technically startable — but not production-closed.
hero.body: الـobservation الحالية أثبتت live topology، source parity، database boundaries، وruntime state. لكنها لم تثبت بعد identity migration، role acceptance، device delivery، backup restore، أو closure لكل عناصر ملف الـDOCX.

poster.summary: السرعة قد تغيّر calendar allocation، لكنها لا تلغي identity risk أو device QA أو restore proof. الـGold surface لازم يعرض الحقيقة قبل الفخامة.

sections.title: ما الذي نعرفه فعلًا؟
sections.body: هذه الطبقة هي التي يجب أن تظهر أولًا أمام صاحب القرار: verified facts، ثم boundaries، ثم ما يمنع إعلان الإغلاق.

entries.label: Observation status
entries.summary: REMOTE OBSERVATION COMPLETE / TARGETED EFFORT-RISK PASS COMPLETE / PROJECT NOT CLOSED.

entries.label: Verified surface
entries.summary: Ubuntu host, Docker Compose, PostgreSQL, Redis, Caddy, live project path, deployed web assets, APK artifact, DB aggregate counts, migrations, backup metadata, and focused source parity were observed.

entries.label: Closure boundary
entries.summary: Production completion, identity migration safety, device acceptance, role acceptance, push delivery, restoreability, and full end-to-end QA remain not proven.

sections.title: Identity, access, and account safety
sections.body: أكبر driver للوقت ليس شكل الـlogin فقط؛ هو reconciliation بين legacy/current، activation، recovery، وbusiness rules.

entries.label: 01 · Users Search Returns 403 Forbidden
entries.summary: Admin/search source and identifier fields exist, but authorized role search and 403 behavior were not tested.

entries.label: 04 · Existing AHS Members Cannot Sign In
entries.summary: Production has 20,789 legacy users and 71 CustomUsers. Existing-member mapping, password compatibility, and sign-in acceptance remain untested.

entries.label: 05 · Sign-Up Does Not Work Consistently
entries.summary: Local new-user paths and tests exist, but production-safe negative/error behavior is not accepted end-to-end.

entries.label: 06 · Login by Membership Number or Card Serial
entries.summary: Current auth contract demonstrates mobile/email-style identifiers; Membership Number or Card Serial login is not established.

entries.label: 13 · Existing User Activation / Migration Access
entries.summary: Activation helper/source exists, but no proof shows safe verification, duplicate prevention, or preservation of the existing membership relationship.

entries.label: 15 · Membership Number in User Profile
entries.summary: Serial fields and local profile display code exist; valid-member ownership and cross-user isolation were not tested on a device or authorized API session.

entries.label: 16 · Forgot Password
entries.summary: Legacy forgot-password route is disabled; the local Flutter login presents an explicit not-active message and the screen file is absent.

entries.label: 17 · Blacklist Management
entries.summary: No blacklist implementation was found in the focused remote/local source scan; rules, audit behavior, and false-positive handling are unapproved.

sections.title: Operational requests, queues, and exports
sections.body: Backend routes and admin workflow helpers exist, but the DOCX acceptance criteria require actual Dashboard role and queue evidence.

entries.label: 02 · QR Code Export
entries.summary: Legacy and current QR populations are verified, but one/many/all export behavior and format/privacy acceptance are not proven.

entries.label: 09 · Requests Missing from Dashboard
entries.summary: Modern request tables contain linked rows in the inspected population, but Dashboard visibility across all request families was not tested.

entries.label: 10 · Full Request Workflow
entries.summary: RequestWorkflowAdminMixin exposes approve/reject actions and status transitions; exact rejection-reason and app-reflection contract remains open.

entries.label: 19 · Pending Queue Cards / Navigation 403
entries.summary: Routes and queue-count source exist, but no authorized role/card matrix was executed against the live Dashboard.

entries.label: 20 · Users Export to Excel
entries.summary: Remote source contains Users export actions and matches local source; UI visibility, filters, permissions, and columns remain untested.

sections.title: Content, data relationships, and modules
sections.body: وجود code أو rows لا يساوي اكتمال الـDashboard-to-app flow. الـGold report يعرض هذا الفرق بوضوح.

entries.label: 03 · News Stops Appearing
entries.summary: Production has 62 News rows; global pagination and local load-more code exist, but the dataset-beyond-failure-point acceptance is open.

entries.label: 07 · Store / Marketplace Dashboard
entries.summary: Store APIs/admin/source exist, but production vendors, categories, products, and orders are all zero. Scope may be empty-by-decision or missing-data.

entries.label: 11 · Academy / Branch Link
entries.summary: 227 academies and 24 branches exist. The targeted probe found zero academy-to-branch orphans, but business correctness and cross-surface display remain untested.

entries.label: 14 · Terms and Conditions
entries.summary: Signup terms checkbox/UI exists locally; approved legal content/version and production acceptance were not observed.

entries.label: 18 · Dashboard Assets and Icons
entries.summary: Live static/media topology, duplicate logos, and remote staticfiles.W004 warning were observed; visual role-based QA remains absent.

entries.label: 21 · Marketing / Application Sliders
entries.summary: Marketing models/admin and static slider assets exist, but production slider tables contain zero rows and Dashboard-to-app flow is unproven.

sections.title: Integrations, migration, release, and handover
sections.body: هذه المجموعة هي التي تمنعنا من تحويل source readiness إلى unconditional deadline.

entries.label: 08 · Push Notifications
entries.summary: Notification records and local notification package exist, but FCM/APNs provider configuration, device tokens, Dashboard send result, and Android/iOS delivery are unproven.

entries.label: 12 · Full Backup and Migration
entries.summary: April dump artifacts exist, but freshness, isolated restore, reconciliation, media completeness, and rollback receipt are not proven.

entries.label: 22 · Old vs Current Dashboard Comparison
entries.summary: A full signed module/page/action/permission comparison checklist is not yet an acceptance artifact.

entries.label: 23 · Full App / Dashboard / API / Infrastructure Review
entries.summary: Server and source surfaces were observed, but mobile, roles, push, migration, and full end-to-end acceptance remain open.

entries.label: 24 · Completion Report and Handover
entries.summary: The evidence package now has explicit statuses and dependencies, but closure sign-off cannot be issued before the acceptance gates pass.

sections.title: Light, Medium, and Hard تغيّر الوقت لا الجودة
sections.body: الـbaseline الحالي يظل 120 ساعة هندسية. الاختلاف بين المودات هو daily allocation وcalendar compression، وليس مستوى الجودة أو معايير القبول.

entries.label: Light
entries.summary: About 6h/day and about 20 working days after access is ready. External waits remain additive.

entries.label: Medium
entries.summary: About 10h/day and about 12 working days after access is ready. Same acceptance quality, tighter coordination.

entries.label: Hard
entries.summary: About 12h/day peak and about 10 working days after access is ready. Fatigue and coordination risk increase; external waits do not disappear.

entries.label: Estimate boundary
entries.summary: Do not present 120h or any deadline as guaranteed until identity, roles, devices, restore, and scope decisions have owners and evidence.

sections.title: مصادر التقرير التي يجب أن تظل ظاهرة
sections.body: كل claim في النسخة Gold لازم يرجع إلى source أو receipt واضح، مع عدم إخفاء حدود التحقق.

entries.label: DOCX master requirements
entries.summary: The authoritative 24-item request list and acceptance language.

entries.label: Final read-only production observation
entries.summary: Remote receipt, source parity, DB observations, backup metadata, 24-item truth matrix, gates, and targeted effort-risk update.

entries.label: Canonical backend source
entries.summary: Local canonical backend used for source-side mapping; not replaced by the Mac/iOS copy.

entries.label: Production project boundary
entries.summary: Observed remote deployment path. The remote tree is not a Git worktree, so no immutable deploy commit is claimed.

entries.label: Runtime and release evidence
entries.summary: Docker services, PostgreSQL/Redis health, migrations, web metadata, APK identity, backup metadata, and staticfiles warning.

sections.title: ما الذي يقفل الملف فعليًا؟
sections.body: هذه ليست decorative checklist؛ كل gate يحتاج owner وevidence قبل تحويل حالته إلى closed.

entries.label: Gate A · Release identity
entries.summary: Explain APK hash mismatch, resolve/document staticfiles warning, and bind deployed artifacts to an immutable receipt.

entries.label: Gate B · Identity and migration
entries.summary: Produce non-PII reconciliation, prove restoreability, test existing-member activation, and prevent duplicates.

entries.label: Gate C · Operations and Dashboard
entries.summary: Run authorized role matrix for search, 403 routes, queues, requests, workflows, rejection reason, and exports.

entries.label: Gate D · Content and integrations
entries.summary: Test News beyond the failure point, decide empty Store/Marketing scope, verify slider flow, and test push delivery.

entries.label: Gate E · Final QA and handover
entries.summary: Fresh Android/iOS/Dashboard/API/infrastructure evidence, bounded backend coverage, and owner-linked handover.

final_moves.title: Next Moves
final_moves.section_title: ما الذي سيحدث بعد اختيار الـGold؟
final_moves.intro: في الرسالة التالية يمكن تحويل هذا payload إلى Omega HUD Gold HTML. الـHTML سيعرض evidence وunknowns كما هي، ثم يمكن استخدامه كمصدر بصري للطباعة أو PDF بعد مراجعة العرض.

moves.label: Freeze this payload
moves.body: اعتبر هذا الملف source payload للنسخة الأولى ولا تضف claim جديدًا من غير evidence.

moves.label: Render Gold HUD
moves.body: استخدم Gold theme DNA: warm cosmic palette، framed glass surfaces، contained hero، وArabic-safe RTL.

moves.label: Keep executive first
moves.body: اعرض verdict والـdecision surface أولًا، ثم matrix والـgates والـtechnical traceability.

moves.label: Preserve uncertainty
moves.body: لا تحوّل OPEN أو BLOCKED أو NOT PROVEN إلى complete لمجرد أن الشكل النهائي elegant.

moves.label: Review before PDF
moves.body: بعد HTML فقط نراجع visual hierarchy والـprint intent؛ PDF export/QA مرحلة منفصلة وليست جزءًا من هذا payload.

execution_order: Render exactly one Omega HUD Gold HTML artifact.
Verify profile metadata, RTL/LTR handling, and responsive surface.
Review executive readability against the 24-item evidence boundary.
Only then consider a separate PDF export and QA pass.

unknowns.label: Identity reconciliation
unknowns.summary: 28 National_ID overlaps are candidate matches, not a proven legacy/current mapping; 71 CustomUsers remain unassigned to Academy/Branch.
unknowns.impact: Can change migration effort, activation design, and acceptance timeline.
unknowns.owner_dependency: Old-server identity authority and non-PII reconciliation approval

unknowns.label: Dashboard role acceptance
unknowns.summary: Source routes and admin workflow helpers exist, but live role/card/queue behavior has not been accepted.
unknowns.impact: Can change the effort for items 1, 9, 10, 19, and 20.
unknowns.owner_dependency: Authorized Dashboard accounts and role matrix

unknowns.label: Mobile and push evidence
unknowns.summary: Remote APK hash differs from local APK; FCM/APNs delivery and device-token lifecycle remain unproven.
unknowns.impact: Can change release identity, notification, and full-QA scope.
unknowns.owner_dependency: Android/iOS devices, install receipt, provider configuration

unknowns.label: Restore and rollback
unknowns.summary: Dumps exist with 2026-04-20 metadata, but no isolated restore receipt exists.
unknowns.impact: Can change migration confidence and deadline; must not be tested destructively on production.

unknowns.label: Empty Store and Marketing scope
unknowns.summary: Production tables are empty while code/assets exist.
unknowns.impact: Can change whether the work is implementation, data preparation, or approved exclusion.

unknowns.label: Legal and blacklist rules
unknowns.summary: Approved Terms content and blacklist matching/audit rules are not present as closed business inputs.
unknowns.impact: Can change implementation and acceptance criteria for items 14 and 17.
